description: This file defines a CollectionView class for managing a collection of item views, including rendering, adding, removing, and swapping views, within a JavaScript MVC framework.

classes.name: CollectionView
classes.description: A view for synchronizing a collection of models with sub views, supporting rendering, adding, removing, and reordering item views.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Initializes and renders all item views to be shown.

methods.name: addItemView
methods.description: Creates a new item view and inserts it into the DOM at the specified index.

methods.name: applyChildViewEvent
methods.description: Adds event listeners to a child view based on the childViewEventMap.

methods.name: removeItemView
methods.description: Removes and disposes of a view at a given index.

methods.name: getViewIndexByModel
methods.description: Returns the index of a view corresponding to a given model.

methods.name: modelFilter
methods.description: Filter function for models; defaults to returning true for all models.

methods.name: onItemEvent
methods.description: Handles collection events to add, remove, or move item views accordingly.

methods.name: swapViews
methods.description: Swaps two views in the DOM.
